Job Title: Associate Director, Drug Safety Physician
Location: Cape Town, South Africa; Remote - South AfricaReports to: Executive Director Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance

Position Summary:

Are you an ambitious Pharmacovigilance Physician who is eager to make an impact in a mission-driven organization?

The Drug Safety Physician in collaboration with the Head of Pharmacovigilance, and PV Specialist will assist with daily drug safety operational activities. A unique opportunity at a 50% part-time allocation, the Physician will collaborate cross-functionally with clinical development, regulatory, biostatistics, and clinical operations while overseeing and the pharmacovigilance vendor. The Physician interacts with internal and external partners, stakeholders, investigators, as well as regulatory agencies on safety topics as necessary.

Help IAVI translate science into global health solutions – learn more and apply below!

Key Responsibilities:

• Participating in the design and conduct of clinical trials to ensure that safety and efficacy data are collected and analyzed appropriately

• Collaborating with other functional units/departments within the company, such as clinical development, regulatory affairs, to ensure that safety and efficacy data are communicated effectively to internal and external stakeholders

• Contributing to the preparation of regulatory submissions and as necessary responding to questions from regulatory agencies regarding the safety of products in development

• Reviewing and approving, as necessary, safety sections of clinical trial protocols and contributing to safety sections of the clinical study report

• Identifying and assessing safety risks associated with investigational products, and making recommendations for managing or mitigating those risks

• Reviewing and analyzing adverse event reports, clinical trial data, and other safety information related to products being evaluated in clinical trials sponsored by IAVI or situations where IAVI has safety reporting obligations

• Provide medical review and completion of analysis of similar events, company causality assessment, and expectedness assessment including review of MedDRA coding for individual safety case reports (ICSRs)

• Contribute to signal detection and risk management for assigned projects.

• Contribute to development of aggregate reports, (DSURs), Investigator’s Brochure updates, Signal detection reports, Safety Management Plans as necessary

• Contribute to oversight of the Pharmacovigilance vendor by reviewing operational compliance reports and the PV unit Risk Register

• Attending monthly project meetings with the PV vendor and the various internal project teams

• Attending Independent Data Monitoring Committee (IDMC) and Global Safety Monitoring Board (GSMB) meetings as necessary

• Assist with ensuring compliance with the requirements of safety data exchange agreements or safety data exchange in clinical trial agreements

• Support the data management team, as necessary, with periodic reconciliation of the clinical and safety databases for assigned projects

• Approve documents requiring filing in the study specific TMF, as necessary

• Support the ED Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance with continuous process improvement initiatives within the Drug Safety and PV unit.

Education and Experience:

· MD or equivalent required

· Minimum 5 years of experience in a clinical research role with at least 3 years in a drug safety role required

· Experience with HIV /infectious diseases or vaccine development preferred

· Experience with clinical trials in Africa preferred

Qualifications and Skills:

· Experience and understanding of safety operations, safety regulations and clinical research principles is required.

· Strong organizational skills, including the ability to work on multiple projects with overlapping schedules and flexibility, as well as to be able to change priorities to meet deadlines and organizational needs.

· Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in large, complex, cross-functional project teams.

· Attention to detail is required and ability to meet timelines in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required.

· Critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify problems and possible solutions, and assess impact on timelines is required.

· Ability to work effectively with teams of diverse educational and cultural backgrounds and maintain a high standard of professional conduct as a representative of IAVI is required.

· Computer and technological literacy, proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and ability to quickly learn and master new systems is required.

· Good knowledge and experience with Medical Dictionary for Regulatory (MedDRA) coding of medical concepts

Organizational Overview:

IAVI is a nonprofit scientific research organization dedicated to addressing urgent, unmet global health challenges including HIV and tuberculosis. Our mission is to translate scientific discoveries into affordable, globally accessible public health solutions. Through scientific and clinical research in Africa, India, Europe, and the U.S., IAVI is pioneering the development of biomedical innovations designed for broad global access. We develop vaccines and antibodies in and for the developing world and seek to accelerate their introduction in low-income countries. IAVI programs and partnerships are grounded in the regions of the world where the disease burden is the greatest, and our approach emphasizes sustainability. Our network of clinical research center partners in Africa and India helps strengthen in-country research capacity and supports the training and education of the next generation of scientists. The global impact of our science includes fundamental contributions to understanding the biology of HIV infection, which IAVI and others are applying toward advancing vaccine science and immunology. IAVI accelerates scientific discovery and development by fostering unique collaborations among academia, industry, local communities, governments, and funders to explore new and better ways to address public health threats that disproportionately affect people living in poverty. Our global reach, including a clinical research network in five countries in sub-Saharan Africa and in India, has allowed us to make fundamental contributions to understanding the epidemiology, transmission, virology, and immunology of HIV. This work played a key role in facilitating the design of promising HIV vaccine candidates, as well as the discovery of broadly neutralizing antibodies that are now being advanced as promising approaches for HIV prevention. Our integrated capabilities in vaccine and antibody discovery, development, and clinical research take advantage of bio-pharmaceutical industry expertise to accelerate the development and testing of prevention methods for HIV and other diseases. Through the Product Development Center, we support external researchers with technical and scientific expertise to accelerate the development of their own products.

IAVI CORE VALUES:

  • Commitment: We deliver on our mission, proactively transforming promises into tangible results
  • Stewardship: We steward IAVI's resources responsibly to ensure IAVI's long-term success and global health impact
  • Integrity: We uphold strong moral principles to maintain our credibility as a nonprofit scientific research organization
  • Collaboration: We work as one IAVI team and partner with others to deliver globally accessible, urgently needed, public health solutions

About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design.

You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Your systems have to handle spikes without losing a single event, scale without anyone stepping in, and stay cheap enough to run at volume.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are hiring someone who has run streaming pipelines in production, has been paged when they broke, and has made them better every time.

Job Description:

  • Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand.
  • Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream.
  • Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost.
  • Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics.
  • Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down.
  • Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • Senior backend engineer: 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years writing production Go. You understand goroutines, channels, and the concurrency patterns that hold up under load.
  • Streaming in production: You have built and operated streaming data pipelines with AWS Kinesis, or a comparable system such as Kafka, at meaningful scale. You understand ordering, partitioning, exactly-once and at-least-once delivery, and replay.
  • AWS IoT or device data: You have worked with AWS IoT Core or another device-telemetry ingestion platform, including MQTT, device authentication, and high-fan-in workloads.
  • Data warehouse experience: You have designed and optimized Amazon Redshift, or a similar warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery, for production analytics. You write strong SQL and know how to make slow queries fast.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: You are strong on AWS (Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and comfortable with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CDK, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain an architecture trade-off to a US product team in plain English and write design documents people actually read.

  • Prospect into insurance agents, agencies and other lead buyers with outbound calls, virtually meetings, email, SMS and other means.
  • Follow up on inbound leads fast. Speed to lead wins deals.
  • Qualify every prospect: lines of business, current lead sources, volume needs, budget and timing.
  • Book demos and meetings for our Account Executives, and do the follow-up that gets them to show to those meetings.
  • Log every call, email, text and note into our CRM, if it's not in our CRM, it didn't happen.
  • Build and work targeted prospect lists by line of business and buyer type.
  • Learn 321 AIM and basic lead economics well enough to run a credible first conversation.
  • Hit your daily and weekly activity, booked-meeting and showed-meeting targets.
  • Feed what you hear on the phones (objections, competitors, what's landing) back to sales and marketing leadership.
  • Help test outreach into our new verticals as they come online.

What success looks like

First 7 days

Learn 321 AIM, our lines of business, our buyer types, our Lead Exchange and our CRM. Nail the pitch and the qualification criteria. Get on the phones, start live outreach and book your first meetings.

30-60 days

Hit full daily activity targets and book meetings consistently, with a healthy show rates as defined by our KPIs. The CRM records are clean and current without anyone chasing you.

60-90 days

You're fully ramped. You're following the proven process that results in a steady flow of booked and shown meetings, your AEs trust the quality of what you hand them, and the opportunities you’ve worked are turning into new accounts.

Ongoing: what we measure

  • Activity: Outbound calls, talk time
  • Meetings booked
  • Show rate (meetings that actually happen)
  • Qualified opportunities passed to AEs
  • New accounts and revenue sourced from your meetings
  • Speed to lead on inbound
  • CRM hygiene

What you bring (must-haves)

  • Experience in a phone-heavy role: SDR/BDR, inside sales, call center or another customer-facing seat.
  • You're comfortable making a high volume of calls every day and hearing "no" without slowing down.
  • Clear, confident communication on the phone, in virtual meetings, by email and by text.
  • Discipline about logging your work in a CRM, every time.
  • Competitive, coachable and motivated by hitting your numbers.
  • Quick learner who's comfortable with a CRM, learning a new platform, a dialer and email tools.

Nice-to-haves

  • Insurance experience (Medicare, home, auto, life/IUL, final expense or ACA), whether selling to agents or working as one.
  • Proven SDR/BRD success
  • Lead generation, pay-per-call or performance marketing sales experience.
  • Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.
  • Exposure to home services, legal or debt relief lead markets.

About Bennie

Bennie () is an employee benefits services and technology firm that helps companies create a healthier workplace. Bennie provides services and technology that are beyond what growing companies typically receive, yet exactly what they need.

Bennie has built the ultimate benefits platform that connects disparate systems across the benefits supply chain to deliver a complete experience for employees, employers, and partners. Bennie’s technology, benefit plans, and service model are designed to enable employers and their employees to experience best-in-class outcomes that reduce overall health plan costs. Bennie’s team members use the platform and its data to supplement their market knowledge and bring innovative solutions to Bennie’s customers.

Bennie is headquartered in Stamford, CT, and is a remote-first company with employees across the U.S.

Core Values at Bennie

As an organization, we value our team members who are Optimistic, Accountable, Thoughtful, and Healthy. We believe these values, known as our O.A.T.H., are essential for our collective success. The ideal candidate for this role will embody these values by:

  • Maintaining a positive attitude throughout our journey of building our company.
  • Being responsible for the quality of their work and for meeting their goals.
  • Respecting our differences and looking out for one another.
  • Believing in living complete lives that balance our work and personal time.

About the Role:

The Enterprise Senior Benefits Consultant is responsible for driving overall customer strategy, complex benefit plan designs, service execution, and long-term retention for Bennie’s enterprise-segment customers (~500+ lives). This role serves as a trusted advisor to C-suite and HR leadership, managing multi-year benefit strategies, self-funded and fully-insured plan architectures, complex carrier negotiations, and vendor ecosystems.

Reporting to: Director of Enterprise Consulting

Who You Are: The ideal candidate possesses deep benefits consulting expertise, exceptional financial and analytical acumen, and a proven track record of managing large, multi-state employer accounts. You are excited to leverage your industry expertise in a technology-forward environment to redefine exceptional consulting service and experience to Bennie’s largest and most complex customers.

The Enterprise Senior Benefits Consultant should exhibit the core attributes of the Bennie consulting team:

  1. Possess a growth mindset to drive the business upward and forward.
  2. Take a proactive approach to value creation and delivery for customers, colleagues, and partners.
  3. Seize the consultative opportunity in every interaction with customers, colleagues, and partners.
  4. Maintain a curiosity about the industry, Bennie’s customers, and Bennie’s business.
  5. Bring relentless intensity to the creation of value.
  6. Take ownership of one’s impact and influence on customers, colleagues, and partners
  7. Work collaboratively with customers, colleagues, and partners.
  8. Act with compassion in every interaction, every time.

Responsibilities include:

  • Customer Strategy & Ownership: Own a strategic book of enterprise-level customers, driving multi-year benefits strategies, plan designs, and executive-level business reviews.
  • Complex Financial & Plan Architecture: Guide customers through self-funding, captive options, contribution strategies, stop-loss placement, and pharmacy benefit management (PBM) optimization.
  • Carrier & Partner Negotiations: Lead high-stakes RFP processes, carrier renewals, and contract negotiations to secure optimal pricing and coverage for enterprise customers.
  • Data & Analytics Integration: Collaborate with analytics resources to analyze claims data, identify cost-drivers, and deliver actionable insights and ROI modeling to executive stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Direct internal service teams (Client Experience Managers, Analysts, Financial Consulting, and Technology Operations) to ensure seamless plan implementation, compliance management, and daily service execution of benefit programs and Bennie’s overall platform.
  • New Business & Onboarding: Partner with Enterprise Sales Account Executives during the sales process to present strategic solutions and lead the smooth transition of newly closed enterprise accounts.
  • Product & Platform Feedback: Partner with internal Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to communicate high-level enterprise customer needs and help guide platform feature development.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of employee benefits consulting experience, specifically managing enterprise/large-group accounts (500+ lives).
  • Active Life & Health Producer’s License.
  • Deep knowledge of complex plan structures (self-funded, level-funded, fully-insured), PBMs, stop-loss, and multi-state compliance (ERISA, ACA, FMLA, COBRA).
  • Proven executive presence with strong presentation and communication skills geared toward C-suite decision-makers.
  • Strong proficiency in data analysis, financial modeling, and MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Professional designations (e.g., CEBS, GBA, RHU).
  • Experience with enterprise HR/Benefits technology platforms and HCM integrations.
  • Team leadership and/or project leadership experience.

Compensation & Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary for this fully remote position, commensurate with experience and qualifications. The estimated annual salary range for this role is USD115,000 to USD145,000*.

*Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Please note that the compensation details listed above reflect the base salary only, and do not include incentive pay, equity, or benefits. Bennie offers a total rewards package that includes stock options and employee benefits for full-time employees.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Flexible Time Off: We have a flexible vacation policy and offer paid company holidays
  • Remote-first environment: Bennie is 100% remote (must be based in the US)
  • Health Benefits that include:
    • Medical/Dental/Vision
    • HSA & FSA, HRA, Life, Disability, & Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Benefits that include:
    • Headspace
    • Wellhub
    • Rocket Lawyer
    • One Medical Membership
    • Kindbody
    • Financial education with Betterment
  • Stock Options: All full-time employees are granted stock options
  • Remote Work Stipend: A $1,000 WFH Stipend
  • Paid Parental & Bonding Leave
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program

Bennie is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Position Summary

The Director of Strategic Procurement, reporting to our VP of Supply Chain, develops and executes enterprise procurement strategies that support IEM’s manufacturing, supply chain, operational, and business growth goals. This role is responsible for building a high-performing procurement function, improving supplier performance, driving cost reduction, reducing supply risk, and ensuring IEM has the supplier base, contracts, and processes needed to support a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate has strong strategic sourcing, supplier management, procurement leadership, and manufacturing experience. This individual should be able to partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and executive leadership to improve material availability, cost competitiveness, supplier accountability, and long-term business continuity.

Note: While candidates based near one of our US plants are preferred, we are open to remote candidates. This role requires approximately 50% travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic procurement plans that support cost, quality, delivery, inventory, working capital, and business continuity goals.
  • Lead procurement strategy across assigned commodities, suppliers, materials, components, and services.
  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a procurement team capable of supporting IEM’s growth, production demands, and operational priorities.
  • Establish supplier strategies that improve cost competitiveness, lead times, capacity, quality, and delivery performance.
  • Lead supplier negotiations related to pricing, contracts, payment terms, lead times, minimum order quantities, stocking agreements, blanket orders, and long-term supply agreements.
  • Drive cost reduction, supplier consolidation, dual sourcing, localization, value engineering, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Partner with Procurement, Planning, Operations, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to align supplier strategies with business and production needs.
  • Analyze spend, supplier performance, market trends, supplier capacity, demand signals, lead times, cost drivers, and supply risks to support sourcing and procurement decisions.
  • Establish procurement processes, tools, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.
  • Manage supplier performance through business reviews, scorecards, corrective actions, escalation management, and long-term supplier development.
  • Support supplier issue resolution related to delivery delays, defects, nonconformance, pricing discrepancies, capacity constraints, and recurring performance concerns.
  • Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring suppliers are held accountable to IEM’s expectations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support new product introduction, capacity expansion, operational improvements, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Ensure procurement data, supplier records, pricing, contracts, and sourcing documentation are accurate and maintained in applicable systems.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts related to procurement processes, supplier performance, material flow, cost reduction, and supply chain reliability.
  • The candidate will be expected to perform additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or supplier management in a manufacturing environment.
  • 5+ years of experience leading procurement, sourcing, or supply chain teams.
  • Experience developing and executing procurement strategies across multiple commodities, suppliers, or business units.
  • Strong experience leading supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, contract management, cost reduction, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing supply chains, supplier lead times, material planning, cost drivers, inventory management, and production support.
  • Ability to make practical procurement and supplier decisions while partnering appropriately with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, negotiation, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience building processes, KPIs, reporting tools, supplier scorecards, and procurement operating rhythms.
  • Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, Microsoft Excel, spend analysis, and supplier performance reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated career growth and increasing responsibility, with the ability to operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on problem solver in a fast-paced, high-growth organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in electrical equipment, power distribution, switchgear, industrial manufacturing, or engineered-to-order manufacturing.
  • Experience with supplier development, localization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, material flow, and value engineering concepts.
  • Experience supporting high-growth manufacturing environments with complex supplier networks and production demands.
  • CPM, CPSM, CSCP, or other procurement/supply chain certification preferred.
  • Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Working Conditions

  • Manufacturing and office environment.
  • May require travel to suppliers or IEM facilities.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, production demands, supplier constraints, and executive-level expectations.

Compensation actually offered for this role will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

Lyra is at the forefront of increasing access to evidence-based, efficacious mental health services on a large scale. Lyra has developed innovative blended models of coaching and psychotherapy that combine leading clinical expertise with routine outcomes monitoring and engaging clinical digital tools. Scientific publications on Lyra’s mental health coaching (Coaching Effectiveness), (Coaching Outcomes), psychotherapy [(Blended Care effectiveness), (Examining Blended Care impact)], (medication management), and overall workforce mental health programs [(Presenteeism impact), (Impact of psychotherapy)] provide strong evidence for the clinical effectiveness of these evidence-based treatment programs.

We are looking for an experienced psychologist with a passion for writing, intervention development, and skills training to contribute to our care programs (including but not limited to our parent coaching program, other programming related to youth and families, as well as adult programs). For this role, strong expertise in child evidence-based mental health interventions is required. This position will be dedicated to writing on clinical topics and upholding a high quality bar for clinical content and programming.

You will be part of a highly skilled, creative, and collaborative team with an established track record for developing effective and engaging interventions and digital clinical materials on emotional wellness and psychotherapy skills. By directly reaching tens of thousands of clients, your work on interventions and digital clinical materials will help create meaningful positive change on a large scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Writing new, engaging clinical content including storytelling and dialogue

  • Developing clinical curriculums and outlines for digital clinical materials

  • Identifying and proposing clinical topics for materials related to evidence-based care (e.g., parenting and managing child externalizing symptoms, youth and families more broadly, adult mental well-being)

  • Reviewing, updating, and editing clinical content to ensure adherence to up-to-date treatment standards

  • Receiving and incorporating significant feedback on your proposals and writing

  • Conducting trainings to help disseminate the use of digital clinical materials

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to produce educational materials and support clinical programming

  • Completing extensive literature reviews to inform outcomes measure selection for a variety of child mental health presentations

  • Conducting presentations and reviewing written content for customers/broader public audience

Qualifications:

  • PsyD, PhD in Clinical / Counseling / School psychology

  • Must have a specialization in pediatric mental health

  • Passionate about increasing access to child mental health and family-based interventions

  • Very strong clinical training and experience with providing evidence-based treatments for child mental health across a variety of clinical presentations (e.g., behavioral parent training, behavior therapy, exposure-based CBT, IPT, ACT, DBT, ERP)

  • Excellent writer with demonstrated writing experience, passionate about writing on clinical topics

  • 3+ years of postdoctoral clinical experience in providing evidence-based treatments for child mental health disorders

  • Experience with creating clinical materials for and training providers to deliver child mental health interventions is a plus

  • Able to think outside the box to create innovative and accessible mental health solutions, openness to working with coaches and paraprofessionals to implement evidence-based skills

  • Comfortable with technology

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment - we move quickly to develop and evaluate clinical programs thus we seek people who are comfortable with constant change, feedback, and improvement

  • Independent, open-minded, non-judgmental, compassionate, and flexible, with excellent interpersonal skills (communication and listening)

  • Functions well in cross-functional contexts (collaborative); previous experience in digital mental health teams (working with Product, Engineering, Marketing, etc.) is a plus

Note on Generative AI for Applicants

While this role is dedicated to the clinical application of generative AI, we are seeking the unique clinical expertise and nuanced clinical judgment that only highly-trained clinicians can provide. As such, we ask that you do not use generative AI to develop your application materials (including cover letter) or when responding to interview questions.

The Technical Trainer & Writer develops and manages product training and knowledge content for a complex clinical trial technology platform. This role goes beyond technical writing. It requires understanding how functionality fits into end-user workflows and the broader content ecosystem. Technical Trainer & Writer works closely with product owners, Customer Engagement, and technical team members to ensure training and knowledge materials are accurate, well-structured, and developed to a high standard.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, job aids, user guides, and training resources alongside each of the four annual software releases.

  • Use release overviews and release notes as the source of truth so content is complete and accurate at the time of each release.

  • Write clear, precise technical documentation that translates complex functionality into language users can understand.

  • Determine where new content belongs within the knowledge base, and how functionality connects across the platform, user roles, and processes.

Reports to: Manager, Renewals

This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure.
  • Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.
  • Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.
  • Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.
  • Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified.
  • Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.
  • Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.
  • Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.
  • Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM’s.

What You’ll Bring

  • Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms.
  • Developing understanding of GitLab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture.
  • Awareness of GitLab's remote work best practices.
  • Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.
  • Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.

About the team

The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>About Ritual&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.</p></div><h4>About the role</h4>
<p>We're seeking a Core Protocol Engineer with deep expertise with Ethereum execution clients to help us extend the EVM for next-generation compute capabilities. You'll work on expanding the execution layer to support novel precompiles, implement parallel execution patterns, and design systems for heterogeneous compute orchestration.</p>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement extensions to EVM clients (Geth/Reth) for supporting stateful precompiles</li>
<li>Implement novel mechanism design primitives, collaborating with our research team, into the execution layer</li>
<li>Develop and optimize transaction processing pipelines for heterogeneous workloads</li>
<li>Research and implement solutions for state access conflicts</li>
<li>Contribute to core protocol development and EIP implementations</li>
<li>Collaborate with the research team on protocol specifications and mechanism design improvements</li>
<li>Design and implement robust testing frameworks for execution client modifications</li>
</ul>
<h4>About you</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deep understanding of EVM internals and Ethereum execution clients (Geth/Reth)</li>
<li>Strong experience implementing and optimizing precompiles</li>
<li>Expertise in Go and/or Rust for systems programming, and Solidity</li>
<li>Thorough knowledge of Ethereum's roadmap and active participation in protocol discussions</li>
<li>Experience with parallel execution patterns in blockchain systems</li>
<li>Strong understanding of consensus mechanisms and blockchain architecture</li>
<li>Ability to read, understand, and implement EIPs and protocol specifications</li>
<li>Proven track record of shipping production-grade blockchain systems</li>
<li>Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency</li>
<li>A high level of end-to-end ownership and self-direction, with excellent communication skills</li>
<li>Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment</li>
</ul>
<h4>Nice to have</h4>
<ul>
<li>Knowledge of mempool dynamics, transaction ordering and the mev-boost implementation</li>
<li>Background in mechanism design or market systems</li>
<li>Deep knowledge of proof systems and their trade-offs around prover time, verifier time, and proof size</li>
<li>Experience optimizing proof generation and verification pipelines</li>
<li>Experience with cross-chain bridges or interoperability protocols</li>
<li>Contributions to Ethereum client codebases</li>
<li>Background in distributed systems and concurrent programming</li>
</ul>
<h4>Why join us&nbsp;</h4>
<ul>
<li>Join a passionate group of engineers, researchers, and operators on a mission to build the next generation of AI infrastructure&nbsp;</li>
<li>Highly competitive compensation package, including annual discretionary bonus &amp; optimized tax structure compared to the vast majority of web3 startups</li>
<li>Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space</li>
<li>100% of premiums covered on highest quality healthcare&nbsp;</li>
<li>Aggressive company 401k match</li>
<li>Fully remote and/or hybrid, up to you!</li>
<li>Participate in virtual and in-person events</li>
<li>Much much more!</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ritual-core-protocol-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ritual-core-protocol-engineer</a></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - MX
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span>The Opportunity&nbsp;</span></h2>
<div><span>As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects).</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.</strong></span></div>
<h2><span><span>What You'll Do</span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span>Your day-to-day</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution.</span></li>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Most content gets made and then dies at a few hundred views, because getting it out is still done by hand: a person, a phone, a few accounts. <p>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Celonis: Client Value Partner (CVP) - Utilities & Energy Industry</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US, Ohio
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2>
<p>We are seeking an established consulting leader—a current Big Four Director, Managing Director, or Partner-track Senior Manager—to spearhead our highest-stakes Energy &amp; Utilities engagements. In this executive-level role, you will serve as the principal strategic architect for our most valuable power, gas, and renewable energy accounts globally.</p>
<p>Leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence platform, you will bridge the gap between macro energy sector strategies and modern cloud/AI execution models, moving clients from slide decks to realized operational value.<br><br></p>
<h2><strong>The Impact You’ll Make</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>1. C-Suite Advisory &amp; Value Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Peer-to-Peer Advisory:</strong> Partner directly with utility C-suite executives (CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers) to align macro pressures—decarbonization, grid modernization, and capital reallocation—with execution-level transformation roadmaps.</li>
<li><strong>Map Enterprise Digital Twins:</strong> Oversee the deployment of the Celonis Process Intelligence Graph to build systemic, end-to-end operational models of complex utility enterprises.</li>
<li><strong>Orchestrate $100M+ Business Cases:</strong> Direct the formulation of board-ready Celonis Value Assessments, delivering the economic justification, working capital improvements, and OPEX returns required to greenlight massive cloud and Edge AI investments.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>2. Transformation Leadership &amp; Ecosystem Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Steer Enterprise Transformations:</strong> Serve as the executive sponsor for high-visibility, Celonis-driven operating model overhauls for Fortune 500 E&amp;U clients, guiding them from diagnostic discovery to closed-loop automation.</li>
<li><strong>Architect Celonis Centers of Excellence (CoEs):</strong> Design and establish corporate-wide CoEs, defining the target operating models, governance structures, and enablement frameworks needed to embed data-driven decision-making into client cultures.</li>
<li><strong>Untangle Systemic Friction:</strong> Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex operational leakages where siloed utility stacks (SAP S/4HANA, IBM Maximo, ADMS/SCADA) collide—specifically optimizing capital procurement, field services, and energy settlement invoicing.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>3. Commercial Growth &amp; Scaled Innovation</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>De-Risk High-Value Sales Cycles:</strong> Convert complex regulatory mandates (FERC, NERC) into automated, visual compliance audits within the Celonis platform, transforming abstract compliance risks into compelling business cases that accelerate C-suite sign-off.</li>
<li><strong>Commercialize Next-Gen "Process + AI" Use Cases:</strong> Direct the integration of industrial telemetry (SCADA, Edge IoT) into Celonis, translating complex data structures into high-margin, executive-ready offerings like real-time storm response and predictive asset failure.</li>
<li><strong>Productize Utility Value Plays:</strong> Codify repeatable client successes into scalable Celonis apps and action templates, establishing a library of industry-specific intellectual property that drives rapid time-to-value, net-new ARR, and account expansion.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Profile We Are Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Consulting Pedigree:</strong> 12+ years of progressive experience within a Big Four or elite management consulting firm, currently operating at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level.</li>
<li><strong>E&amp;U Vertical Expertise:</strong> Deep, authoritative knowledge of the Energy &amp; Utilities sector (Grid Operations, Transmission &amp; Distribution, Generation, or Retail), with a track record of leading multi-million-dollar transformation programs.</li>
<li><strong>SaaS &amp; Process Intelligence Vision:</strong> Strong conceptual understanding of Process Mining paradigms. Experience with Celonis is highly advantageous, but a proven ability to leverage enterprise software to reshape business processes is required.</li>
<li><strong>Architectural Fluency:</strong> Comprehensive understanding of the modern enterprise stack (SAP, Oracle, Maximo) and emerging data/AI paradigms (Azure AI, LLMs). <em>Note: You do not need to write code or SQL queries, but you must possess the technical fluency to direct data scientists, engineers, and solution architects.</em></li>
<li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Proven capability in client origination, relationship management, and driving account growth through value-based selling.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems. An MBA from a top-tier business school is highly preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>
<p>Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YR5oRJGhJYg&amp;list=PLuVor-ZUD4pnM6G33C5D0tjXUvlTPYBRe">video</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p>
<p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p>

The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.<br><br>The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. In this executive-level role, you will serve as the principal strategic architect for our most valuable Upstream, Midstream, Downstream, and LNG accounts globally.</p>
<p>Leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence platform, you will bridge the gap between macro energy transition strategies and modern cloud/AI execution models, moving clients from slide decks to realized operational value.</p>
<h2><strong>The Impact You’ll Make</strong></h2>
<h3><strong> C-Suite Advisory &amp; Value Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Peer-to-Peer Advisory:</strong> Partner directly with Oil &amp; Gas C-suite executives (CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers) to align macro pressures—capital discipline, decarbonization, yield optimization, and supply chain volatility—with execution-level transformation roadmaps.</li>
<li><strong>Map Enterprise Digital Twins:</strong> Oversee the deployment of the Celonis Process Intelligence Graph to build systemic, end-to-end operational models of complex oilfield, pipeline, or refining enterprises.</li>
<li><strong>Orchestrate $100M+ Business Cases:</strong> Direct the formulation of board-ready Celonis Value Assessments, delivering the economic justification, working capital improvements, and OPEX returns required to greenlight massive cloud, IoT, and Edge AI investments.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong> Transformation Leadership &amp; Ecosystem Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Steer Enterprise Transformations:</strong> Serve as the executive sponsor for high-visibility, Celonis-driven operating model overhauls for Fortune 500 O&amp;G clients, guiding them from diagnostic discovery to closed-loop automation.</li>
<li><strong>Architect Celonis Centers of Excellence (CoEs):</strong> Design and establish corporate-wide CoEs, defining the target operating models, governance structures, and enablement frameworks needed to embed data-driven decision-making into client cultures.</li>
<li><strong>Untangle Systemic Friction:</strong> Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex operational leakages where siloed O&amp;G stacks (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, IBM Maximo, Hydrocarbon Accounting systems) collide—specifically optimizing mega-project capital procurement, asset turnaround management, and joint venture accounting.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong> Commercial Growth &amp; Scaled Innovation</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>De-Risk High-Value Sales Cycles:</strong> Convert complex regulatory, environmental, and safety mandates (EPA, OSHA, BSEE, API standards) into automated, visual compliance audits within the Celonis platform, transforming abstract risk management into compelling business cases that accelerate C-suite sign-off.</li>
<li><strong>Commercialize Next-Gen "Process + AI" Use Cases:</strong> Direct the integration of industrial telemetry (refinery IoT, pipeline SCADA, digital oilfield data) into Celonis, translating complex data structures into high-margin, executive-ready offerings like predictive asset integrity and real-time carbon intensity tracking.</li>
<li><strong>Productize Oil &amp; Gas Value Plays:</strong> Codify repeatable client successes into scalable Celonis apps and action templates, establishing a library of industry-specific intellectual property that drives rapid time-to-value, net-new ARR, and account expansion.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Profile We Are Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Consulting Pedigree:</strong> 12+ years of progressive experience within a Big Four or elite management consulting firm, currently operating at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level.</li>
<li><strong>O&amp;G Vertical Expertise:</strong> Deep, authoritative knowledge of the Oil &amp; Gas sector (Upstream exploration/production, Midstream logistics, Downstream refining/petrochemicals, or LNG), with a track record of leading multi-million-dollar transformation programs.</li>
<li><strong>SaaS &amp; Process Intelligence Vision:</strong> Strong conceptual understanding of Process Mining paradigms. Experience with Celonis is highly advantageous, but a proven ability to leverage enterprise software to reshape business processes is required.</li>
<li><strong>Architectural Fluency:</strong> Comprehensive understanding of the modern enterprise stack (SAP, Oracle, Maximo) and emerging data/AI paradigms (Azure AI, LLMs). <em>Note: You do not need to write code or SQL queries, but you must possess the technical fluency to direct data scientists, engineers, and solution architects.</em></li>
<li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Proven capability in client origination, relationship management, and driving account growth through value-based selling.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Petroleum, Chemical, or Industrial preferred), Computer Science, or Information Systems. An MBA from a top-tier business school is highly preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.</strong></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>
<p>Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YR5oRJGhJYg&amp;list=PLuVor-ZUD4pnM6G33C5D0tjXUvlTPYBRe">video</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p>
<p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p>

<p>Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/candidate-notices">Accessibility and Candidate Notices</a></p>
<p>By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/privacy-notice/">Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools</strong><br><br>We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.<br><br>The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.</p>
<p>Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/fraud-alert/">here</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Reddit: Analytics Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p>We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.</p>
<p>Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.</li>
<li>Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data</li>
<li>Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.</li>
<li>Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines</li>
<li>Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems</li>
<li>Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.</li>
<li>Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field</li>
<li>3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.</li>
<li>Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.</li>
<li>Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.</li>
<li>Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.</li>
<li>Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.</li>
<li>Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic AI-assisted development experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.</li>
<li>Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/">https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p>
<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit <a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p>
<p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.</p></div><div class="title">The base salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$164,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$229,990 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p>
<p><span>During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://growthminded.co">https://growthminded.co</a>
</p>

<div class="space-y-12">

<h2 class="text-3xl font-medium">About the role</h2>
<p class="mt-5 whitespace-pre-line text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#526760]">You'll own the data layer underneath InsightsOS and EngageOS, the products that turn booking, CRM, ad, and financial data from multi-location brands into proactive insights and automated actions. Today that layer is built and maintained by our product lead alongside two full-stack engineers. We need someone who owns it end to end: architecture, modeling, pipelines, and the analytical models on top. You'll report to our product lead and work directly with the founder.</p>
<p class="mt-5 text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#526760]"><strong>Compensation:</strong> $45–60K plus revenue-share bonus (we profit share every month)</p>


<h2 class="text-3xl font-medium">What you'll do</h2>
<ul class="mt-5 list-disc space-y-3 pl-6 text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#526760]">
<li>Design and own the semantic layer and aggregation architecture across clients with 2 to 250 locations each.</li>
<li>Build and maintain pipelines from sources like Mindbody, Zenoti, Boulevard, Mariana Tek, Domo, QuickBooks Online, GA4, Google Ads, Meta, and Klaviyo.</li>
<li>Develop trend, utilization, and propensity models that power proactive insights and lifecycle triggers.</li>
<li>Work with Claude Code and AI-assisted tooling as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought.</li>
<li>Establish data quality, governance, and row-level security patterns as we move into multi-tenant, franchise-level reporting.</li>
<li>Self-direct discovery and architecture decisions, and write clear technical specs the rest of the team can execute against.</li>
<li>Join a daily product sync with the product lead and engineering team.</li>
</ul>


<h2 class="text-3xl font-medium">Who you are</h2>
<ul class="mt-5 list-disc space-y-3 pl-6 text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#526760]">
<li>2+ years in data engineering with real ownership of a production analytics platform.</li>
<li>Deep in SQL and Python, strong with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework, warehouse design (BigQuery, Postgres), and orchestration.</li>
<li>Experience with semantic or metrics layers and aggregation at scale, you've solved the "same metric, different answers" problem before.</li>
<li>Practical ML: propensity scoring, forecasting, and anomaly detection in a product context.</li>
<li>Comfortable making architecture calls without a spec handed to you, and communicating clearly across time zones in writing.</li>
<li>Bonus: multi-location, franchise, or subscription business data; marketing or CRM integrations; multi-tenant SaaS.</li>
</ul>


<h2 class="text-3xl font-medium">Why this role</h2>
<ul class="mt-5 list-disc space-y-3 pl-6 text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#526760]">
<li>Full ownership of a product vertical, not a ticket queue.</li>
<li>Small team, direct impact, your models show up in client revenue within weeks.</li>
<li>Build the cross-client data asset that is central to our strategy.</li>
</ul>

</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/growth-minded-senior-data-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/growth-minded-senior-data-engineer</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sweden
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://career.proxify.io">http://career.proxify.io</a>
</p>

<h3><strong>The Role:</strong></h3>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer skilled in React.js and Node.js for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
